name: Hammersmith and Fulham

applications.description:
***AMENDED DESCRIPTION*** Hybrid application for the
phased redevelopment of Plot 3 of the masterplan site through demolition of all
above-ground existing buildings and structures, site remediation, and creation of
residential floorspace (Use Class C3) (up to 88,123 sq.m GEA excluding basement), flexible
ground floor commercial, business and service floorspace (Use Class E) (up to 890 sq.m
GEA), basement (up to 8,172 sq.m GEA) in buildings ranging in height up to 31 storeys
(maximum 98 metres from ground), with associated public realm, infrastructure and
associated works, comprising:
Outline proposals for residential floorspace including ancillary residential facilities (Use
Class C3) (up to 69,696 sq.m GEA excluding basement and up to 698 homes), basement of
up to 4,753 sqm GEA and flexible commercial, business and service floorspace (Use Class
E) (up to 890 sq.m GEA), new pedestrian, cycle and vehicular access, open space,
landscaping, car and cycle parking, infrastructure and associated works; and
Detailed proposals for residential floorspace (Use Class C3) (18,427 sq.m GEA excluding
basement, 198 homes), basement of 3,419 sqm GEA, new pedestrian, cycle and vehicular
access including bus route and associated facilities, open space, landscaping, car and
cycle parking, infrastructure and associated works.

pipr.sourceWorkbook: ONS Price Index of Private Rents UK monthly price statistics, 19 August 2026

affordableHousingSupply.note: Win condition uses this completions pace, not the London Plan 35% policy target.

nursePay.hcas: Inner London 20% of basic, min £5,794 max £8,746 from 1 April 2026
nursePay.note: Inner London 20% of basic, min £5,794 max £8,746 from 1 April 2026

takeHomeAssumptions.note: Transparent 2026/27 England PAYE sketch for the nurse only (NHS pension). Private renter has no pension deduction in this model. Not official tax tables.

nurse.label: Band 5 nurse
nurse.housing: houseshare at 42% of PIPR 1-bed (full 1-bed already exceeds 40% take-home at baseline)

renter.label: Private renter
renter.incomeNote: Modelled inner-London professional salary for the scenario, not ASHE/median. Tenure mix (36.2% PRS) is 2018.

family.label: Family of four
family.incomeNote: Two Inner London Band 5 entry salaries as a visible public-service household, not a household-income survey.

stakes.snapshotNote: Official snapshot, not live. TA not in this pack unless extracted per borough — do not use Tower Hamlets 3,096 here.

crimeNote: Street-crime counts are precomputed per application from data.police.uk May 2026. No point cloud shipped.
